# ui::TableProvider

Header: `winui/ui/Automation.hpp`.

The Table pattern: a [Grid](../layout/grid.md#uigrid) with column headers. Implement every member.

## table_column_headers

```cpp
virtual void table_column_headers(std::vector<Element*>& out) const = 0
```

Appends the column headers' nodes to `out`. A table is read row by row and has no row headers.

## ~TableProvider

```cpp
~TableProvider() = default
```
